summary: DAY structural/causal review completed independently for all 12 companies in the Chief-selected active T0 batch. Each company has a reproducible company-to-technology-to-bottleneck-to-infrastructure-to-human-need map with successor constraints and explicit falsifiers. All 12 are structurally ready_for_chief; this lane-readiness does not override underwriting blockers or the global discovery gate.

companies.causalChain: AI capability demand -> GPU/accelerator clusters -> powered data-center capacity, networking and cooling -> enterprise/hyperscaler compute -> productivity and digital services
successorBottlenecks: utilization/value capture after capacity is built
power efficiency and interconnect as raw GPU access eases
companies.falsifier: Dedicated capacity is persistently underutilized or industry compute pricing falls faster than Nebius can reduce delivered-cost per unit, breaking durable value capture despite physical capacity growth.
documentedUnknowns: relative economics of owned versus leased/financed capacity

companies.causalChain: security, agriculture, climate and infrastructure monitoring -> high-cadence Earth observation -> satellite constellation plus data/analytics platform -> geospatial intelligence -> faster real-world decisions
successorBottlenecks: analysis/decision integration as raw imagery becomes more abundant
trusted sovereign access and latency
companies.falsifier: Lower-cost constellations or fused non-Planet datasets provide equal cadence/quality with weaker switching costs, causing renewal/backlog quality to deteriorate materially.
documentedUnknowns: degree of analytics moat versus imagery commodity risk

companies.causalChain: reliable low-carbon firm power need -> advanced fission generation -> reactor design, licensing, fuel and siting -> grid/data-center/industrial power -> energy security and electrification
successorBottlenecks: repeatable manufacturing and project-finance cost after licensing
fuel-cycle scale and site interconnection
companies.falsifier: Licensed deployments fail to achieve bankable lifecycle cost/reliability versus gas plus renewables/storage or customers do not convert interest into enforceable offtake at acceptable economics.

companies.causalChain: digital compute and Bitcoin demand -> powered sites, ASICs and increasingly AI-capable data-center infrastructure -> mining/AI workloads -> digital monetary and compute services
bottlenecks: conversion of powered sites into high-density AI infrastructure
successorBottlenecks: AI customer acquisition and cluster economics after power is secured
capital allocation between mining and AI uses
companies.falsifier: Incremental AI conversion earns subpar returns relative to mining/site value while hash economics deteriorate, leaving power assets capital-intensive without durable higher-value workloads.

companies.causalChain: advanced computation/networking need -> trapped-ion quantum systems, networking and vertically integrated fabrication -> quantum workloads -> optimization, simulation and secure-network optionality
successorBottlenecks: repeatable chip/system manufacturing after qubit scale
application software and enterprise integration if hardware reaches fault-tolerant thresholds
companies.falsifier: The platform fails to demonstrate economically relevant advantage as scale increases, or a competing modality reaches useful fault tolerance with materially better cost/throughput before IonQ's roadmap does.
documentedUnknowns: relative modality economics at large logical-qubit counts

companies.causalChain: labor scarcity and fulfillment-speed pressure -> warehouse robotics/software -> automated storage, retrieval and case handling -> distribution infrastructure -> lower time/labor per unit moved
successorBottlenecks: software orchestration and maintenance economics as hardware standardizes
customer diversification and implementation capacity
companies.falsifier: Economics fail to replicate outside anchor customers or modular AMR/alternative automation achieves comparable throughput with lower integration cost and switching burden.

companies.causalChain: AI compute scaling -> custom silicon, electro-optics and high-speed networking -> rack/cluster scale-out -> cloud/AI infrastructure -> lower cost and higher throughput per model workload
successorBottlenecks: interconnect/optics as accelerator abundance rises
software/ecosystem compatibility around custom silicon
companies.falsifier: Hyperscalers internalize key design capability or rival ASIC/network vendors displace Marvell in major programs, reducing durable design-win share and pricing leverage.

companies.causalChain: AI bandwidth growth -> lasers, transceivers, photonic components/materials -> optical datacenter links -> cluster networking -> scalable compute connectivity
successorBottlenecks: co-packaged optics/manufacturing yield as pluggable optics scale
laser efficiency and thermal control at higher link rates
companies.falsifier: Copper remains economical materially longer than expected or competing photonics supply commoditizes critical components enough to erase Coherent's performance/capacity advantage.

companies.causalChain: AI cluster bandwidth and power-efficiency need -> high-power lasers/optical transceivers/CPO-NPO components -> optical fabric -> datacenter interconnect -> scalable accelerator utilization
successorBottlenecks: laser/photonic integration for CPO
customer concentration and capacity allocation once supply expands
companies.falsifier: Integrated silicon-photonics architectures materially reduce external laser/component content or competing suppliers add qualified capacity fast enough to collapse scarcity rent and margin durability.

companies.causalChain: AI rack power-density growth -> power-management ICs/modules and higher-voltage conversion -> server/rack power delivery -> data-center electrical infrastructure -> efficient reliable compute
successorBottlenecks: 800V/high-voltage rack architectures
power-stage integration and system-level efficiency after raw capacity expands
companies.falsifier: Platform integration or competing power architectures bypass a meaningful share of discrete MPS content, or rapid capacity expansion weakens pricing/margins without durable design-win growth.

companies.causalChain: AI/network infrastructure demand -> design, manufacturing and supply-chain integration of compute/network systems -> hyperscaler deployment -> cloud/AI capacity -> digital compute services
successorBottlenecks: higher-value design/engineering versus commodity assembly
program diversification after capacity ramps
companies.falsifier: Hyperscaler vertical integration or lower-cost ODM competition commoditizes Celestica's contribution enough that incremental AI volume no longer supports durable margin/return improvement.
documentedUnknowns: long-run mix of higher-value versus commodity manufacturing

companies.causalChain: higher-speed data, electrification, defense and industrial connectivity -> connectors, cables, sensors and interconnect systems -> physical signal/power delivery -> digital/physical infrastructure -> reliable communication and control
bottlenecks: qualified engineered interfaces across fragmented end markets
successorBottlenecks: optical/electrical co-integration as bandwidth rises
integration of acquired capabilities into broader system content
companies.falsifier: Optical/integrated architectures remove connector content faster than Amphenol adapts, or acquisition-led expansion materially erodes ROIC/quality while end-market diversification fails to offset it.

contradictions: Physical bottleneck exposure does not by itself prove company value capture: NBIS power/GPU capacity, BTDR powered sites and OKLO licensing/fuel constraints require separate underwriting of economics.
Optical scarcity can support both COHR and LITE while also inviting capacity response; structural importance and pricing durability must remain separate concepts.

AI infrastructure growth benefits MRVL, COHR, LITE, MPWR, CLS and APH through different nodes; duplicated macro demand is not independent evidence and should not be counted multiple times as one underlying event.
unknowns: Future successor-bottleneck timing is scenario uncertainty, not a present blocker where the current causal link is sourced and falsifiable.
No causal edge is proposed as canonical until Chief independently verifies/promotes it under the append-only governance contract.
peerRequests: Company-underwriting: keep value-capture evidence separate from structural criticality for NBIS, OKLO and BTDR.
Beta red team: test optical oversupply/architecture substitution for COHR/LITE and hyperscaler vertical-integration risk for MRVL/CLS.
Discovery lane: watch successor constraints in AI power/interconnect/optics and advanced nuclear fuel/licensing without counting correlated headlines as independent origins.
